request.text: A PowerShell session on WORKSTATION5 appears to be replicating credentials from the domain controller (DCSync). Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: A high-integrity PowerShell session of pgustavo (PID 7456) ran whoami /user and then connected from WORKSTATION5 to the domain controller's RPC endpoint mapper (135) and to its lsass RPC port (49674). A workstation process speaking directory replication RPC to the DC is DCSync credential theft; isolate WORKSTATION5 now.

permitted.note: rule A rule 2: WORKSTATION5.theshire.local is the request's host; policy P1-tier0-isolate (needs approval); fulfils the request

rule A rule 2: powershell.exe (PID 7456) acts on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local and is part of the attack (the Empire agent speaking replication RPC to the DC); policy P7-irreversible-tier01 (needs approval); does not fulfil the request (side action)

rule A rule 2: whoami.exe (PID 1852) acts on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local and is part of the attack (whoami /user run by the agent); policy P7-irreversible-tier01 (needs approval); does not fulfil the request (side action)
rule A rule 2: pgustavo acts on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local and ran the attack; policy P4-human-account; does not fulfil the request (side action)
